description: Parent POM updated to support PostgreSQL Managed Identity authentication via Spring Cloud Azure. Added spring-cloud-azure-dependencies BOM with version 5.22.0, which is the correct version for Spring Boot 3.2.1.

Web module POM updated to include spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql dependency. This dependency provides Spring Boot auto-configuration for PostgreSQL passwordless authentication using Managed Identity.
Worker module POM updated to include spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql dependency. Ensures consistent Managed Identity authentication setup across both application modules.

Web module application properties migrated from hardcoded password-based authentication to Azure Managed Identity. Original plaintext credentials (postgres/postgres) replaced with environment variable references and passwordless authentication configuration. Comprehensive comments added for Azure sovereign cloud and service principal authentication alternatives.

issues.description: Placeholder value 'spring.cloud.azure.credential.client-id=<your_managed_identity_client_id>' uses angle bracket notation instead of being an environment variable reference. While this matches the migration skill example, it should be replaced with an environment variable like ${MANAGED_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID} before deployment for consistency with other properties in the file.
